macros.name: GetDocumentCommandArgSpec
macros.doc: These functions transfer the current argument specification for the requested ⟨function⟩ or ⟨environment⟩ into the token list variable \ArgumentSpecification.

macros.name: ShowDocumentEnvironmentArgSpec
macros.doc: These functions show the current argument specification for the requested ⟨function⟩ or ⟨environment⟩ at the terminal.
